DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's disease)

Based on the classic triad of a pruritic rash, symmetric sensory loss (numbness/tingling) in the palms, and loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, combined with your history as a farmer, these findings are highly specific for leprosy. I will recommend a skin biopsy and skin smear for *Mycobacterium leprae* to confirm the diagnosis.
